verdict.rationale: Linear documents native iOS and Android apps. The mobile app supports reviewing code changes, commenting on specific lines and iterating with Linear Agent (linear-docs-6), and creating and editing documents (linear-docs-71). That shows real and growing mobile capability, but nothing explicitly covers issue or task management on mobile or claims parity with desktop. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of core task and issue management (create, triage, update status, views) in the mobile app, any claim or proof of feature parity with desktop, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile completeness.
